message.content:
**Yes – you can file a noise complaint in Atlanta.**  
In the United States, “local council” usually refers to the city’s governing body (the City Council), but noise complaints are typically handled by the city’s **Police Department** or **Code Enforcement** office. Here’s how you can do it:

| Step | What to Do | Where to Go / Who to Call |
|------|------------|---------------------------|
| 1 | **Check the Noise Ordinance** – Know what constitutes a violation (e.g., loud music after 10 p.m., construction noise during restricted hours). | City of Atlanta website: <https://www.atlantaga.gov/311> (search “Noise Ordinance”) |
| 2 | **File an Online Complaint** – Use the 311 portal to submit a noise complaint form. | 311 portal: <https://www.atlantaga.gov/311> |
| 3 | **Call 311** – If you prefer speaking to someone or don’t have internet access. | Phone: 404‑656‑4000 (or dial 311 from any Atlanta phone) |
| 4 | **Contact the Police Department** – For immediate or urgent noise issues (e.g., ongoing disturbance). | Atlanta Police Department: <https://www.atlantaga.gov/department/police> |
| 5 | **Follow Up** – After filing, you’ll receive a case number. Keep it handy for any follow‑up questions. |

### Quick Contact Details

| Agency | Phone | Online Portal |
|--------|-------|---------------|
| **Atlanta Police Department** | 404‑656‑4000 | <https://www.atlantaga.gov/department/police> |
| **City of Atlanta 311** | 404‑656‑4000 | <https://www.atlantaga.gov/311> |
| **City Code Enforcement** | 404‑656‑4000 (via 311) | <https://www.atlantaga.gov/department/code-enforcement> |

### Tips for a Successful Complaint

1. **Be Specific** – Include the exact location, time, and nature of the noise.  
2. **Provide Evidence** – If possible, attach photos, videos, or audio recordings.  
3. **Use the Official Form** – The online portal will guide you through all required fields.  
4. **Keep Records** – Save confirmation emails or screenshots of your submission.

### Legal Basis

Atlanta’s noise ordinance is part of the city’s **Code of Ordinances** (Title 12, Chapter 12 – Noise). Violations can result in citations, fines, or other enforcement actions. The ordinance is publicly available on the city’s website and can be reviewed for specific prohibited activities and enforcement procedures.

---

**Bottom line:** Yes, you can report a noise complaint to the City of Atlanta. Use the 311 system or call the police department, and you’ll be directed to the proper channel for handling the issue.
